notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q5653859_ara_san_juan.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/sailkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. At about 907-920 m in a ravine some 460 km off the Valdés peninsula: the pressure hull in one larger piece, imploded, the stern crushed and telescoped, the plating split, debris spread over some 70 m. A memorial: 44 died. The damage, the layout and the heading (not published here: 0) are approximate. model_built.glb: the submarine as she was in 2017. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
